description: WhatsApp is reportedly planning to add Meta One subscription plans directly to the Android app. The Meta One subscription plans were spotted on WhatsApp beta for Android version 2.26.23.10. With this, the user will be able to access and manage the plans directly from within WhatsApp.Users who sign up for any of these plans are likely to get WhatsApp Plus benefits as part of the package, with access to premium features across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, and Meta AI through a single subscription.
title: WhatsApp Could Soon Offer Meta One Plus, Meta One Premium Subscriptions With Additional Features

description: A Falcon 9 rocket launched 24 Starlink satellites from California, expanding the constellation beyond 10,600 spacecraft. The mission also brought booster B1071 within one flight of SpaceX’s Falcon 9 reusability record.
title: Starlink Constellation Crosses 10,600 Satellites After Latest SpaceX Launch

description: An international law enforcement operation spanning 11 countries has dismantled AudiA6, a cryptocurrency money-laundering network accused of processing more than $390 million between 2022 and 2025. The crackdown resulted in arrests, asset seizures, and the freezing of cryptocurrency.
title: Authorities Shut $390 Million Crypto Money-Laundering Scheme in International Sting Operation

description: Samsung Galaxy A27 5G has been listed on the company’s website in the Czech Republic. The listing confirms that the upcoming Galaxy A series phone will be powered by an octa core Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 chipset. Moreover, the smartphone will be backed by a 5,000mAh battery. The Samsung Galaxy A27 5G will also feature a triple rear camera system, headlined by a 50-megapixel main shooter, along with a 5-megapixel ultrawide camera and a 2-megapixel macro camera. On the front, the handset will feature a 12-megapixel selfie camera. It will be offered in Black, Blue, Light Green, and Light Pink colourways.
title: Samsung Galaxy A27 5G Listing on Czech Website Leaves Little to the Imagination Ahead of Imminent Debut

description: Fresh leaked images have revealed the purported iPhone 18 Pro Max in Dark Cherry, Light Blue, and Black finishes ahead of its expected launch later this year. The Dark Cherry option is tipped to be the standout colour for the Pro lineup, while the black model appears to feature a subtle two-tone design. Previous reports suggest the iPhone 18 Pro series could feature Apple's A20 Pro Bionic chip, a smaller Dynamic Island, and a new C2 modem.
title: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro Max Leaks in New Hands-On Images Ahead of Anticipated September Launch Event

description: Asus Chromebook CM32 Detachable has been launched in India alongside the Chromebook CM14 and Chromebook CM15. The Asus Chromebook CM32 Detachable features a 12-inch touch screen display with 2.5K resolution and Corning Gorilla Glass protection. All three models run on ChromeOS and are equipped with a MediaTek Kompanio 540 processor paired with up to 8GB of RAM.
title: Asus Chromebook CM32 Detachable With 2.5K Display Launched in India Alongside Chromebook CM14, CM15

description: A new leak suggests Honor is developing a smartphone with a battery exceeding 10,000mAh and a display capable of reaching 10,000 nits of peak brightness. The information comes from a tipster, although no details about the phone's name or specifications have surfaced. The leak follows Honor's recent focus on large-battery smartphones, including the Win, Win RT, Win Turbo, and Power 2 models. If launched, the handset could set new benchmarks for both battery capacity and display brightness.
title: Honor Tipped to Launch Smartphone With 10,000-Nit Display and 10,000mAh Battery

description: Nothing Ear 3a could launch in France at EUR 99 (roughly Rs. 10,900), according to a new leak. The earbuds are expected to be available in white, black, yellow, and a new pink colour option. The reported price matches the launch price of the Nothing Ear (a), despite rising costs across the consumer electronics market. Nothing has not yet confirmed any specifications or launch details. The earbuds were previously spotted on Indonesia's SDPPI certification database alongside the unannounced CMF Buds Neo.
title: Nothing Ear 3a to Arrive With Familiar Price Tag, New Colourway: Report

description: Pine Labs Payment Protocol (P3P) was launched in India on Thursday. The financial technology company said that it is a new payment infrastructure that enables AI agents to autonomously complete UPI transactions. P3P is claimed to eliminate the need for manual authentication during payments. It is built upon the existing UPI mandate framework. As per the company, users can authorise spending rules once and let AI agents execute purchases on their behalf.
title: Pine Labs Launches P3P Agentic Payment Protocol for Autonomous UPI Transactions in India

description: Citigroup has launched a blockchain-based marketplace that will allow investors to buy and sell exposure to private company shares through tokenised depositary receipts. The platform is initially aimed at foreign investors and seeks to expand access to private markets.
title: Citi Debuts Blockchain-Based Marketplace Focused on Private Company Shares: Report

description: Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge is now available in India with a Rs. 50,000 discount compared to its launch price. The handset is currently available via Flipkart at a discounted price of Rs. 59,999 for the base 12GB + 256GB RAM and storage configuration. The handset is currently listed in two colour options, namely Titanium Jetblack and Titanium Silver. The Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge boasts a 5.8mm thick body that weighs about 163g. The smartphone sports a 6.7-inch Quad-HD+ (1,440 x 3,120 pixels) Infinity-O Dynamic AMOLED 2X display, offering up to 120Hz of refresh rate and Corning Gorilla Glass Ceramic 2 protection. A custom octa core Snapdragon 8 Elite for Galaxy chipset powers the Galaxy S25 Edge.
title: Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge Price in India Drops to All-Time Low: Specifications, Features

description: Nothing co-founder and CEO Carl Pei has warned that smartphone prices could continue rising as memory costs increase due to growing demand from the AI industry. He said memory prices have surged significantly and are becoming one of the most expensive smartphone components. According to Pei, manufacturers may have to raise prices or reduce specifications to offset higher costs. He also claimed that some recently launched phones are already more expensive than their predecessors and suggested further price increases could follow.
title: Nothing CEO Carl Pei Predicts Smartphones May Not Get Major Discounts During Sales Due to Ongoing Chip Shortage

description: Astronomers have discovered a powerful galactic wind in the merging galaxy system CRISTAL-02. The outflow is removing star-forming gas faster than it can be replenished, providing the first direct evidence for a mechanism that may have shut down star formation in massive early galaxies.
title: Astronomers Discover Why Massive Galaxies Died Early in the Universe

description: A new leak reveals the purported screen covers for Samsung's upcoming foldable smartphones. The screen covers appear to be designed for the external displays of foldables Galaxy Z Flip 8, Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Galaxy Fold 8 Ultra. The image offers a side-by-side comparison of the Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, and Galaxy Z Flip 8 in the folded state. The book-style foldables could run on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 processor, while the Galaxy Z Flip 8 is expected to run on Exynos 2600 chipset.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, Z Fold 8 Ultra and Z Flip 8 Display Shapes Revealed via Leaked Image of Screen Protectors

description: Sweet Magnolias Season 5 follows three best friends as they embrace new opportunities, relationships and personal growth.
title: Sweet Magnolias Season 5 Now Streaming Online: What You Need to Know

description: OnePlus Nord Buds 4 will be launched in India soon, the tech firm announced on Friday. On top of this, a dedicated microsite for the new true wireless stereo (TWS) is now live in the country, confirming its availability in India via Amazon. The company has also teased the design of the upcoming OnePlus Nord Buds 4. The earbuds are shown to boast an in-ear design, with silicone tips at the end. Moreover, it appears with a pebble-shaped charging case, similar to the OnePlus Nord Bds 4 Pro.
title: OnePlus Nord Buds 4 India Launch Teased as Company Reveals Colour, Design

description: The Evil Lawyer is a Thai legal thriller web series that is now available to stream only on Netflix, with eight episodes.
title: The Evil Lawyer Out on OTT: Know Where to Stream This Thai Legal Thriller Web Series Online

description: Honor X80 Pro Max is expected to go official soon. Ahead of the official announcement, its design has been leaked through live images. The renders show the phone in a cream colour option with a dual-tone design. It has a circular rear camera module. It is tipped to feature an 11,000mAh battery with 90W charging support. It is likely to run on a Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 chipset.  has been leaked through live images.
title: Honor X80 Pro Max Surfaces Online via Leaked Live Images; Tipster Reveals Key Specifications

description: The Honor X7e 4G was recently launched in select global markets as the latest addition to the brand’s X7 lineup. The rumour mill suggests that it could be joined by another handset soon. An upcoming Honor phone, ubiquitously known as the Honor X7e Plus 5G, was recently spotted on multiple certification sites, indicating its launch in select global markets beyond China. While the listings do not reveal any specifications, it does hint towards its imminent debut.
title: Honor X7e Plus 5G Reportedly Listed on TDRA and SGS Databases, May Launch in UAE and Other Global Markets

description: Google has started rolling out the Android 17 Quarterly Platform Release (QPR1) Beta 4 version to Google Pixel 6 and newer phones and Pixel Tablet, the Mountain View-based tech giant announced on June 10. The new firmware version brings various bug fixes. Google has highlighted seven “top” bug fixes. The new update resolves an issue where the mouse pointer would automatically become invisible on external monitors. The issue appeared when “Work profile or FLAG_SECURE applications” were in use.
title: Google Android 17 QPR1 Beta 4 Update Rolls Out to Pixel Devices With Fixes for Major Bugs, Issues

description: Vivo X Fold 6 confirmed to be the first smartphone to launch with the MediaTek Dimensity 9500 Super Edition chipset. This chipset is said to be different from the standard MediaTek Dimensity 9500. The Vivo X Fold 6 is confirmed to launch soon. It is already confirmed to ship with OriginOS 6 Fold. It is rumoured to feature an 8-inch inner screen and a 6.51-inch outer display.
title: Vivo X Fold 6 Confirmed to Launch With Custom Dimensity 9500 Chip Developed With MediaTek for Foldables

description: Bitcoin held above $63,000 despite rising oil prices, inflation concerns, and uncertainty surrounding the upcoming Federal Reserve meeting. Analysts said improving on-chain data and stronger support levels have helped stabilise sentiment, though institutional participation remains subdued.
title: Bitcoin Remains Steady as Rising Oil Prices and Investor Caution Fuel Inflation Fears

description: A gripping crime drama where three individuals challenge a feared ruler’s empire in a 1990s port town.
title: Isakapatnam OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: Lenovo has launched the Yoga True Wireless Noise Cancelling Earbuds in China at a starting price of CNY 599 (roughly Rs. 8,300). The earbuds feature 12.2mm dynamic drivers, active noise cancellation of up to 40dB, and three microphones on each earbud for calls. They support dual-device connectivity, instant pairing with Lenovo Yoga PCs, and customisation through Lenovo PC Manager. The earbuds are claimed to offer up to 36 hours of total battery life with the charging case.
title: Lenovo Yoga True Wireless Noise Cancelling Earbuds Launched With 40dB ANC, Up to 36 Hours of Total Battery Life

description: Apple has long been rumoured to be developing a MacBook with touchscreen support. For years, the Cupertino-based tech giant has resisted introducing touchscreen displays on Macs, arguing that the iPad is better suited for touch-based interactions. A new leak, however, suggests that Apple’s stance could finally change, and an upcoming MacBook is confirmed to feature a touchscreen display, marking a first for the company. The tipster, however, did not reveal a launch timeline or specific model details.
title: Apple’s Upcoming MacBook ‘Confirmed’ to Feature Touchscreen Support, Tipster Claims

description: The OTT platforms have dropped a new set of movies and series, including Bhooth Bangla, Raakh, Dridam, and more.
title: New OTT Releases This Week ( June 8 - June 14): Bhooth Bangla, Raakh, Dridam, Karuppu, Maa Hai Na, and More

description: Samsung has begun rolling out the One UI 9 beta to Galaxy S26 series users in select regions. The update introduces new productivity, accessibility, and security features, while separate reports indicate that Samsung is testing the software on more Galaxy phones and foldables. One UI 9 also adds a real-time network speed meter through Good Lock's QuickStar module and lets users disable the ongoing activity indicator displayed in the status bar.
title: Samsung's One UI 9 Beta Now Available to Test on Galaxy S26 Series; Wider Roll Out Could Follow

description: Oppo executive Chen Xi on Weibo stated that ColorOS 17 will not feature a significant design overhaul. Instead, the upcoming release will prioritise improvements to the fundamental user experience. Additional features set to be introduced over time. The new post by the Oppo executive comes as a response to a recent post by Digital Chat Station. The tipster said that ColorOS 17 would adopt more Liquid Glass-style design elements.
title: Oppo Working on Improving User Experience With ColorOS 17 Update, Executive Says No New Features or Major Design Updates Expected

description: 1666 Amsterdam developer Panache Digital Games has apologised for AI-generated assets present in the game's playable prologue demo on PC. After users spotted AI assets in the prologue, the studio acknowledged concerns and said the assets in question would be removed in an update "soon".
title: 1666 Amsterdam Developer Apologises for AI Assets in Playable Demo, Promises No AI in Final Game

description: YouTube announced the expansion of its in-app messaging feature to 40 countries. This feature was previously limited to two regions. YouTube's in-app video sharing and messaging feature lets users share all types of videos like Shorts, live streams and have conversations right where they're watching. This can be done by clicking the messaging icon within the YouTube app to send an invite to share videos and react in real-time.
title: YouTube Brings Its In-App Chat and Video Sharing Features to More Countries

description: Realme Narzo Days sale has kicked off, bringing discounts on various Realme Narzo series phones. The sale event is scheduled to conclude on June 16. The deals are exclusively available in India via Amazon. During the sale event, the Realme Narzo 100 Lite 5G is available at a discounted price of Rs. 15,249, coming down from its listed price of Rs. 27,999 for the base 4GB + 128GB RAM and storage variant. On the other hand, the Realme Narzo Power 5G, which packs a 10,001mAh battery, the largest cell equipped in a Narzo series phone, is available at Rs. 27,999, instead of its regular price of Rs. 35,999.
title: Realme Narzo 100 Lite 5G, Realme Narzo Power 5G and More Discounted During Ongoing Narzo Days Sale

description: OpenAI is said to be considering significantly reducing the prices it charges customers for using its AI models. According to a report, the ChatGPT maker is evaluating a strategy where it may slash its token pricing, which is the usage-based metric commonly used by AI companies to bill customers. The move is reportedly driven by the company’s intensifying rivalry with Anthropic, which has also been rumoured to lower its prices in the future.
title: OpenAI Said to Be Considering Lower Token Pricing Amidst Growing Rivalry With Anthropic

description: Moto G Max 5G was recently launched in select global markets. The new smartphone is currently on sale via the Motorola Brazil online store. The handset is offered in two colour options, dubbed Azul Claro and Graphite (translated from Portuguese), and a single 8GB + 256GB RAM and storage configuration. An octa core MediaTek Dimensity 6400 chipset, which is built on a 6nm process, powers the new Moto G Max 5G. The smartphone also boasts a 5,200mAh battery with support for 33W wired fast charging. It sports a 6.8-inch 1.5K Super HD Extreme AMOLED display.
title: Moto G Max 5G Launched With 5,200mAh Battery, 200-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Wikipedia has introduced “Which came first?” for iPhone users through the latest update to its iOS app. Available via the Explore section, the daily quiz asks players to place historical events in the correct chronological order. The game features five new challenges each day, with questions based on notable events linked to that date in history. Users can also revisit previous quizzes through an archive and track statistics such as average scores and streaks. The feature previously debuted on Android.
title: Wikipedia Brings ‘Which Came First?’ History Trivia Game to iPhone a Year After Launch on Android

description: Meta on Thursday announced several football-focused features across its family of social media apps ahead of the FIFA World Cup 2026. The company is partnering with broadcasters, national teams, players, commentators, and creators to bring fans closer to the action throughout the tournament. Users will be able to access features like real-time conversations, live scores, football communities, themed experiences, and AI-powered additions across Threads, Instagram, Facebook, Messenger, and WhatsApp.
title: Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp Get Football-Themed Features Ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026

description: The Oppo Reno 16 series is expected to launch in India and the global markets soon. Recently, the standard Reno 16’s global and Indian variant was sighted on a benchmarking site, revealing key specifications. Now, the entire lineup has surfaced on a European retailer's website. The listing reveals pricing, colour options, and storage variants for multiple Reno 16 series models, including the standard Reno 16, Reno 16 Pro, and Reno 16 FS.
title: Oppo Reno 16 Series Price, Storage Variants Leak via European Retailer Listing
